description.value: Melee touch — this doesn't age flesh, only metal. Make a melee spell attack roll against the item's AC (an unwilling wielder may instead attempt a Reflex save to snatch it clear). Success the item corrodes, taking a permanent −1 item penalty until repaired by a smith (1 hour, Crafting DC equal to the item's level). Critical Success as success, but the penalty is −2. This penalty does not stack past −2 from repeated castings.

target.value: 1 creature's worn armor or held metal weapon
